To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>

Subject: Weekly XFN: Bricklist & escalation lane for QBR prep

Team —
Attached is the initial 'bricklist' for next week's QBR (tabbed by risk area). I'm opening this thread so we can consolidate owners and surface anything that needs an exec ask. High-level asks:

- Confirm owner for each brick by EOD Thu
- Mark any items that require SLA exceptions or procurement lead time
- Call out blockers that require legal/security evidence (SOC 2 / data residency)

Attachments: QBR_prep_bricklist.xlsx (xlsx, 120KB)

Helen — adding you so Acme can flag any missing acceptance criteria on the integration side.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
Head of Product Operations
Redwood Inference

On Thu, Aug 16, 2028 at 09:12, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Attached is the initial 'bricklist' for next week's QBR ...

Thanks, Irene — I reviewed the spreadsheet and added a new tab ("integration gating") with three items that need product acceptance from Acme and two items that require updated security artifacts. Quick notes from my side:

- Owner assignments: assigned Matt (integration) to the two API contract items; assigning Naomi to the customer success checklist item.
- Risk: the data residency ask from Acme on the logging side will need a PoC to validate — marked as P0
- Timeline: procurement lead time for a dedicated VPC/Private deployment is ~18 business days (unless we agree to a short-term hosted exception)

I linked the related ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-1423 — please add any estimated effort so we can aggregate for the exec ask.

Marissa
Sr. Solutions PM, Redwood Inference

From: Helen Park <h.park@acmecloud.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Acme Cloud integration team <acct-team@acmecloud.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2028-08-16T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly XFN: Bricklist & escalation lane for QBR prep

Hi Irene / Marissa —

Thanks for pulling this together. A couple clarifying questions from Acme: 

1) For the data residency PoC, are you proposing a short-term config on Redwood hosted or a scoped Private deployment? We need dates — procurement has a freeze week next month.
2) For the API contract items, can you provide the expected acceptance tests or a sample request/response (we can validate internally if provided before the QBR)

If you can call out the timeline options (hosted exception vs dedicated lead time) in the bricklist, that will help our procurement and legal coordinate.

Thanks — Helen
Helen Park | Head of Platform Partnerships, Acme Cloud

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Helen Park <h.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2028-08-17T10:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly XFN: Bricklist & escalation lane for QBR prep

Quick response to Helen and the team —

- Pricing/procurement: short-term hosted exception (i.e., temporary hosted with contract addendum) will be the fastest path (~3 business days to approve paperwork + access). Dedicated/Private requires the full procurement window (~18 business days) and an SOW for VPC configuration. I've added both options with estimated cost deltas in INF-1423.
- Acceptance tests: Marissa, I'll drop a simple Postman collection and sample request/response into the Drive link today. Naomi, can you own validating the acceptance checklist for CS?

Vivek — we should consider an exec-level exception to fast-track the hosted addendum for Acme so they can complete integration before their freeze week. If you approve, I will prepare the short exec memo (ask: 2-week runway, waiving standard reserved capacity commit for initial prod). Attached: security_requirements.pdf (pdf, 250KB) — the security team has flagged two outstanding artifacts that Acme needs to sign off on.

Thanks,
Karthik
Director, Revenue Engineering

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodinference.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Helen Park <h.park@acmecloud.com>
Date: 2028-08-18T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Weekly XFN: Bricklist & escalation lane for QBR prep

Thanks for the context. I'm OK with a narrow exec exception to support a hosted addendum for Acme to finish integration before their procurement freeze. Conditions: 

- Limit to 2 weeks and explicit rollback plan to avoid open reserved commitments
- Legal to confirm amended contract language by EOD Mon
- Security to provide the two outstanding artifacts and a sign-off checklist before we flip to prod

Irene — please surface this as an "exec ask" on the QBR slide deck and include the cost delta (Karthik has the numbers in INF-1423). Naomi — can you work with Marissa to produce a one-slide summary of risk, mitigation, and ask for the QBR? Target: slide ready by Tue morning.

Vivek
VP, Product
Redwood Inference
